title: Relative perfectness over a flat finitely presented algebra is equivalent to boundedness below plus boundedness of every residue field fibre
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The statement characterizes relative perfectness of a pseudo-coherent complex over a flat finitely presented algebra by two conditions: boundedness below of the complex and boundedness below of each of its residue field fibres over the base (statement lines 22204-22213). The easy direction is immediate from bounded tor dimension, while the converse requires reducing the algebra to a polynomial algebra over the base, invoking the local perfectness criterion over a regular fibre prime by prime, then the stalk criterion for perfectness and finally the identification of perfect complexes with relatively perfect ones (proof lines 22215-22244). The reduction and the two applications of the local criteria are the substance of the proof. The counted span refers four times to results of this chapter, all carried as navigation stubs.
